adjudication_basis: Only adjudication-packet-v2.2 content, case dictionaries, excerpts, label-specific evidence, and frozen-corpus expertise evidence. No popularity fields and no outside-web evidence used.

global_rules.relevance_gate: case semantic metrics other than relevance score only on sources adjudicated relevant=true
global_rules.unresolved_rule: UNRESOLVED is excluded from numerator and denominator; never treated as false
global_rules.historical_authority: UNRESOLVED for all real case labels in this adjudication because the packet omits timestamp/age evidence needed for 'long-established' status
global_rules.expertise: SUPPORTED means sufficient topic-conditioned expertise evidence exists; vendor bias does not negate expertise, but does not imply evidence quality or neutrality
global_rules.evidence_quality: External-link presence alone is insufficient; quality requires concrete first-hand/technical support or identifiable external research/data evidence
global_rules.long_tail: Only proposal-positive low-distribution candidates can be confirmed true without exposing popularity metadata; semantic uniqueness is adjudicated here
global_rules.claim_stance: Only substantive same-claim positions are retained; generic sentiment/insults/questions are removed

c1-yida-verdict.note: substantive positive/negative overall assessment exists after stance cleanup

c2-yida-ecosystem.note: substantive ecosystem advantage vs boundary/cost opposition exists

c1-criteria-vs-business-first.note: same decision question has framework-first vs business-first positions

c2-vendor-neutrality.note: vendor promotion vs neutrality is source-type/provenance tension, not substantive same-claim opposition

c1-source-value.note: clear substantive pro/against positions on practical value of source delivery

c1-innovation-vs-repackaging.note: not material to permission-control pitfalls; it contaminated the case with generic low-code debate

xq4-vendor-tension.note: requires vendor-self-promotion plus independent/countervailing evaluation groups; old all-vendor groups were insufficient
